Ward.label: Ward
Ward.description: A zone of a settlement with its own character.

BuildingParcel.label: Building parcel
BuildingParcel.description: A parcel whose primary object is a building.

Civic.label: Civic building
Civic.description: A temple, guard post or other public building.

OpenSpace.label: Open space
OpenSpace.description: A square or plaza: open ground with a centrepiece.

Yard.label: Yard
Yard.description: Open ground belonging to a parcel.

PlantedArea.label: Planted area
PlantedArea.description: Ground given to plants: gardens, beds, fields, orchards, meadows.

LinearFeature.label: Linear feature
LinearFeature.description: Something built along a line of cells: walls, fences, hedges.

WaterSource.label: Water source
WaterSource.description: Where people draw water: a well or fountain.

NatureArea.label: Nature area
NatureArea.description: A forest, meadow or rock field.

Crossing.label: Crossing
Crossing.description: Carries a path over an obstacle.

Room.label: Room
Room.description: A room of an interior or a dungeon: the unit they are counted in.

DungeonRoom.label: Dungeon room
DungeonRoom.description: A room or chamber of a dungeon or cave.

Level.label: Level
Level.description: A floor of a building or a level of a dungeon: laid out on its own, linked by stairs.

FurnitureGroup.label: Furniture group
FurnitureGroup.description: An anchor piece and the pieces around it (a table and its chairs).

PointOfInterest.label: Point of interest
PointOfInterest.description: Something worth walking to in the wild: a ruin, a shrine, a cave mouth.

Site.label: Site
Site.description: A place within a region, built later as a place of its own.

Fortification.label: Fortification
Fortification.description: Walls, towers and gates that defend a place.

District.label: District
District.description: A zone of a modern city with its own use: a downtown, a suburb, an industrial estate.

Office.label: Office
Office.description: A parcel of offices: a tower, an office building.

Commercial.label: Commercial
Commercial.description: A parcel that sells: shops, a mall, restaurants, a hotel, a gas station.

Industrial.label: Industrial
Industrial.description: A parcel that makes or stores goods: a factory, a logistics warehouse.

PublicService.label: Public service
PublicService.description: A school, hospital, police or fire station, city hall.

Infrastructure.label: Infrastructure
Infrastructure.description: What a place runs on: roads, parking, transit, utilities.

Parking.label: Parking
Parking.description: Where vehicles stand: a lot, a garage.

Transit.label: Transit
Transit.description: Where people board public transport: a station, a stop.

Park.label: Park
Park.description: A public green: lawns, trees, paths, benches.
